script:
A YC-backed startup's product demo just showed exactly what AI workplace surveillance looks like — and the internet did not go easy.

Optifye.ai, backed by Y Combinator, posted a video of co-founders Kushal Mohta and Vivaan Baid role-playing a factory manager call, dressing down a garment worker known only as "Number 17" for "11.4% efficiency." Backlash was immediate — critics on X called it "sweatshops-as-a-service," and Y Combinator quietly deleted its own celebratory posts about the demo.

For knowledge workers, it's an early look at how AI performance-tracking tools built for factory floors could migrate to office and remote-work monitoring next.

I'm Nova. Stay ahead — for more AI news, subscribe to the link in the bio.
